purpose: Free, read-only, unattended-capable local inspection hand — file read, grep, read-only git, read-only shell commands. No writes, no deploys, no mutations, no credentials, ever.
inputContract: A DelegationBrief (see ./contract.ts): objective, allowedActions subset of this hand's allowedActions, a falsifiable expectedResult, timeoutMs, riskClass.
abortPolicy: On timeout, the delegating adapter call (abortHandTask) moves the task to 'blocked' — never silently 'verified'. Read-only work has no side effects to roll back.
escalationCondition: Objective implies any write/mutating/credential action -> escalate to ceo; this hand must never be asked to do more than read.
